sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subjects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_code" TEXT NULL, "color_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK (length(course_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 20), CHECK (color_index BETWEEN 0 AND 9));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES subjects (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "deadline_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "deadline_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "estimated_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium', "grade_weight_pct" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'incomplete', "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), CHECK (description IS NULL OR length(description) <= 5000), CHECK (type IN ('assignment', 'project', 'quiz', 'exam', 'reading', 'other')), CHECK (date(deadline_date) IS deadline_date), CHECK (deadline_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (estimated_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 10000), CHECK (priority IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')), CHECK (grade_weight_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CHECK (status IN ('incomplete', 'inProgress', 'completed')), CHECK ((status = 'completed') = (completed_at IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "planned_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_end" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned', "is_pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pinned" IN (0, 1)), "is_ad_hoc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_ad_hoc" IN (0, 1)), "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "segment_started_at" INTEGER NULL, "accumulated_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "actual_minutes" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (planned_end > planned_start), CHECK (status IN ('planned', 'active', 'paused', 'completed', 'skipped')), CHECK (accumulated_seconds >= 0), CHECK (actual_minutes IS NULL OR actual_minutes >= 0), CHECK ((status = 'active') = (segment_started_at IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_live_session ON study_sessions ((1)) WHERE status IN ('active', 'paused') AND deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX study_sessions_planned_start ON study_sessions (planned_start)
CREATE INDEX study_sessions_task_status ON study_sessions (task_id, status)
CREATE INDEX tasks_deadline_date ON tasks (deadline_date)
CREATE INDEX tasks_subject_id ON tasks (subject_id)
CREATE INDEX tasks_status ON tasks (status)

CREATE TRIGGER availability_delete_bumps_data_version AFTER DELETE ON availability BEGIN UPDATE data_version SET value = value + 1 WHERE id = 1;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "preferred_session_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "break_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "daily_limit_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 240, "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "notifications_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("notifications_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "show_task_names_in_notifications" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_task_names_in_notifications" IN (0, 1)), "week_start_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "default_estimate_assignment" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 120, "default_estimate_project" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 360, "default_estimate_quiz" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 90, "default_estimate_exam" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 240, "default_estimate_reading" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60, "default_estimate_other" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60, "significant_diff_pct" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 25, "significant_diff_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "exam_revision_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, "last_successful_export_at" INTEGER NULL, "backup_nudge_dismissed_at" INTEGER NULL, "onboarding_completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1), CHECK (preferred_session_minutes BETWEEN 15 AND 180), CHECK (break_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 60), CHECK (daily_limit_minutes BETWEEN 30 AND 960), CHECK (theme_mode IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')), CHECK (week_start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK (default_estimate_assignment BETWEEN 15 AND 480), CHECK (default_estimate_project BETWEEN 15 AND 480), CHECK (default_estimate_quiz BETWEEN 15 AND 480), CHECK (default_estimate_exam BETWEEN 15 AND 480), CHECK (default_estimate_reading BETWEEN 15 AND 480), CHECK (default_estimate_other BETWEEN 15 AND 480), CHECK (significant_diff_pct BETWEEN 5 AND 100), CHECK (significant_diff_minutes BETWEEN 5 AND 240), CHECK (exam_revision_days BETWEEN 0 AND 30));

CREATE TRIGGER settings_scheduling_update_bumps_data_version AFTER UPDATE OF preferred_session_minutes, break_minutes, daily_limit_minutes, exam_revision_days ON settings WHEN OLD.preferred_session_minutes IS NOT NEW.preferred_session_minutes OR OLD.break_minutes IS NOT NEW.break_minutes OR OLD.daily_limit_minutes IS NOT NEW.daily_limit_minutes OR OLD.exam_revision_days IS NOT NEW.exam_revision_days BEGIN UPDATE data_version SET value = value + 1 WHERE id = 1;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "milestones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 200));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "estimate_calibration" ("task_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_applied_at" INTEGER NULL, "dismissed_at_qualifying_count" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_type"), CHECK (task_type IN ('assignment', 'project', 'quiz', 'exam', 'reading', 'other')));
